“Nepal is completely safe, and its people are incredibly loving!” An Indian moto-vlogger currently traveling through the country has shared a heartwarming message online, strongly dismissing negative rumors regarding tourist safety in Nepal. While obtaining his ACAP permit for a journey to Muktinath, the rider was deeply moved by the exceptional hospitality of a local Nepali travel agency couple. Upon learning he was a visiting tourist from India, the agency owner—an ex-Indian Army Gorkha veteran—offered his personal contact number for safety, reassuring him, "You are from our home. If you face any trouble anywhere, just message me." Touched by the gesture, the vlogger urged fellow travelers to visit without hesitation, emphasizing that the positive energy you bring is exactly the kind of warmth you will receive in return.
